note: Steps are a simple guide as of the date shown. Requirements and fees change: always check the official site before you go.

items.title: Create a My.SSS account
steps: Get your SSS number first (online SS number application on the SSS site) if you don't have one.
Go to the SSS website or the My.SSS app and choose Register.
Enter your SS number, name, birth date and an email you can open.
Confirm through the link/OTP sent to your email or phone, then set your password.
Log in to check contributions, loans and benefits. UMID/ID card applications are done through SSS; follow its current instructions.
steps_tl: Kunin muna ang SSS number (online na application sa site ng SSS) kung wala ka pa.
Pumunta sa website ng SSS o sa My.SSS app at piliin ang Register.
Ilagay ang SS number, pangalan, kaarawan, at email na mabubuksan mo.
Kumpirmahin sa link o OTP na ipinadala sa email o telepono, tapos magtakda ng password.
Mag-log in para tingnan ang kontribusyon, loan, at benepisyo. Ang aplikasyon ng UMID o ID card ay sa SSS; sundin ang kasalukuyang tagubilin nito.
items.tip: SSS never asks for your password by text or chat.
items.tip_tl: Hindi hihingi ng SSS ang password mo sa text o chat.

items.title: Claim SSS benefits (sickness, maternity, unemployment, retirement)
items.title_tl: Mag-claim ng benepisyo sa SSS (sakit, maternity, unemployment, retirement)
steps: Log in to My.SSS and enroll a disbursement account (bank or e-wallet listed by SSS).
Check you have the required number of paid contributions for that benefit.
File the benefit online in My.SSS (or at a branch if required) and upload the documents asked.
Track the claim status in My.SSS; payment goes to your enrolled account.
steps_tl: Mag-log in sa My.SSS at i-enroll ang disbursement account (banko o e-wallet na nakalista sa SSS).
Tingnan kung sapat ang bayad na kontribusyon para sa benepisyong iyon.
I-file ang benepisyo online sa My.SSS (o sa branch kung kinakailangan) at i-upload ang hinihinging dokumento.
Subaybayan ang status sa My.SSS. Papasok ang bayad sa naka-enroll na account.

items.title: Save with Pag-IBIG MP2
steps: Be an active Pag-IBIG member (get your MID number via Virtual Pag-IBIG).
Enroll in MP2 online through Virtual Pag-IBIG and save your MP2 account number.
Pay through Virtual Pag-IBIG, accredited partners or a branch.
Dividends are announced yearly by Pag-IBIG; the term is 5 years.
steps_tl: Maging aktibong miyembro ng Pag-IBIG (kunin ang MID number sa Virtual Pag-IBIG).
Mag-enroll sa MP2 online sa Virtual Pag-IBIG at itago ang MP2 account number.
Magbayad sa Virtual Pag-IBIG, sa accredited na partner, o sa branch.
Inaanunsyo ng Pag-IBIG ang dividend kada taon. Limang taon ang termino.

items.title: Apply for a Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose or Housing Loan
items.title_tl: Mag-apply ng Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose o Housing Loan
steps: Check eligibility (number of monthly savings and active membership) on the Pag-IBIG site.
Prepare a valid ID and proof of income.
Apply online through Virtual Pag-IBIG (multi-purpose/calamity) or submit housing loan requirements to a branch or developer.
Wait for approval; proceeds go to your Pag-IBIG Loyalty Card Plus or bank account.
steps_tl: Tingnan ang eligibility (bilang ng buwanang hulog at aktibong membership) sa site ng Pag-IBIG.
Ihanda ang valid ID at patunay ng kita.
Mag-apply online sa Virtual Pag-IBIG (multi-purpose o calamity) o isumite ang requirements ng housing loan sa branch o developer.
Hintayin ang approval. Papasok ang proceeds sa Pag-IBIG Loyalty Card Plus o bank account.
items.tip: Beware of fixers. Pag-IBIG processing is done only through official channels.
items.tip_tl: Mag-ingat sa fixer. Sa opisyal na channel lang pinoproseso ng Pag-IBIG.

items.title: Register with PhilHealth and use benefits
items.title_tl: Magparehistro sa PhilHealth at gamitin ang benepisyo
steps: Register through the PhilHealth Member Portal or a PhilHealth office to get your PIN.
Update your contribution category (employed, self-employed, OFW, etc.).
Add qualified dependents.
When admitted to an accredited facility, present your PhilHealth ID/PIN so benefits are deducted from your bill.
steps_tl: Magparehistro sa PhilHealth Member Portal o sa opisina ng PhilHealth para makuha ang PIN.
I-update ang kategorya ng kontribusyon (employed, self-employed, OFW, at iba pa).
Idagdag ang qualified na dependent.
Kapag na-admit sa accredited na pasilidad, ipakita ang PhilHealth ID o PIN para mabawas ang benepisyo sa bill.

items.title: Get your PhilSys National ID
steps: Register at a PhilSys registration center (check PSA/PhilSys announcements for sites near you).
Bring a valid supporting document (e.g., PSA birth certificate).
Have your biometrics taken.
Get your ePhilID or download the digital National ID when available; the physical card is delivered later.
steps_tl: Magparehistro sa PhilSys registration center (tingnan ang anunsyo ng PSA o PhilSys para sa lugar malapit sa iyo).
Magdala ng valid na supporting document (halimbawa, PSA birth certificate).
Ipakuha ang biometrics mo.
Kunin ang ePhilID o i-download ang digital National ID kapag available. Darating ang physical card mamaya.

items.title: Apply for a Philippine passport (DFA)
steps: Book an appointment only at the official DFA site (passport.gov.ph).
Pay the fee through the listed payment channels.
Bring your confirmation, PSA birth certificate (first-time) and a valid ID on your schedule.
Choose delivery or pick-up and track your passport.
steps_tl: Mag-book ng appointment sa opisyal na site lang ng DFA (passport.gov.ph).
Bayaran ang fee sa nakalistang payment channel.
Dalhin ang confirmation, PSA birth certificate (first-time), at valid ID sa iskedyul mo.
Piliin ang delivery o pick-up, at i-track ang passport.
items.tip: Only use passport.gov.ph. Fake booking sites exist.
items.tip_tl: passport.gov.ph lang ang gamitin. May pekeng booking site.

items.title: Get an NBI clearance
steps: Register at clearance.nbi.gov.ph.
Fill in your details and choose an NBI branch and schedule.
Pay through the listed channels.
Go to the branch for photo and fingerprints; with a 'HIT' you may need to return later.
steps_tl: Magparehistro sa clearance.nbi.gov.ph.
Punan ang detalye at pumili ng NBI branch at iskedyul.
Magbayad sa nakalistang channel.
Pumunta sa branch para sa litrato at fingerprint. Kung may HIT, maaaring bumalik ka mamaya.

items.title: Get a police clearance
steps: Register at the National Police Clearance System site.
Book a station and schedule, then pay online or at the station.
Bring two valid IDs; photo and fingerprints are taken at the station.
steps_tl: Magparehistro sa site ng National Police Clearance System.
Mag-book ng station at iskedyul, tapos magbayad online o sa station.
Magdala ng dalawang valid ID. Sa station kinukuha ang litrato at fingerprint.

items.title: Register with BIR as a freelancer (TIN, Form 1901, 8% option)
items.title_tl: Magparehistro sa BIR bilang freelancer (TIN, Form 1901, 8% option)
steps: Register through BIR's ORUS online system or at your RDO using BIR Form 1901 (self-employed/professionals).
Choose your tax type. If gross sales/receipts are ₱3M or less, you may opt for the 8% income tax rate in your first quarter return.
Get your Certificate of Registration (Form 2303), register books of accounts and get authorized invoices.
File and pay quarterly/annual returns on time (eFPS/eBIRForms or accredited agents).
steps_tl: Magparehistro sa ORUS ng BIR o sa RDO mo gamit ang BIR Form 1901 (self-employed o professional).
Piliin ang uri ng buwis. Kung ang gross sales o receipts ay ₱3 milyon pababa, maaari mong piliin ang 8% income tax rate sa unang quarter return.
Kunin ang Certificate of Registration (Form 2303), irehistro ang books of accounts, at kumuha ng authorized na invoice.
Mag-file at magbayad ng quarterly at annual return sa oras (eFPS, eBIRForms, o accredited agent).
items.tip: Tax rules change. Check BIR issuances or ask your RDO. Not tax advice.
items.tip_tl: Nagbabago ang patakaran sa buwis. Tingnan ang issuances ng BIR o tanungin ang RDO. Hindi ito tax advice.

items.title: Start freelancing safely
steps: Learn a skill with free courses (TESDA Online, DICT trainings).
Make an honest portfolio: show your real work only.
Use reputable platforms; never pay to 'get hired' and never share OTPs.
Use written contracts and milestone payments.
Register with BIR and keep records of income.
steps_tl: Matuto ng skill sa libreng kurso (TESDA Online, training ng DICT).
Gumawa ng tapat na portfolio: tunay mong gawa lang ang ipakita.
Gumamit ng kilalang platform. Huwag magbayad para matanggap, at huwag magbahagi ng OTP.
Gumamit ng nakasulat na kontrata at milestone na bayad.
Magparehistro sa BIR at magtabi ng rekord ng kita.
items.tip: If a job offer sounds too good, check SEC and DMW advisories.
items.tip_tl: Kung masyadong maganda ang alok, tingnan ang advisory ng SEC at DMW.

items.title: Register a small business
steps: Register your business name with DTI BNRS online (sole proprietor) or SEC (corporation/partnership).
Get a barangay clearance where your business is located.
Apply for a Mayor's/Business Permit at your city or municipal hall (BPLO).
Register with BIR (Form 1901 or 1903), get invoices and books.
Register employees with SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG if you hire.
steps_tl: Irehistro ang business name sa DTI BNRS online (sole proprietor) o sa SEC (corporation o partnership).
Kumuha ng barangay clearance kung saan ang negosyo.
Mag-apply ng Mayor's o Business Permit sa city o municipal hall (BPLO).
Magparehistro sa BIR (Form 1901 o 1903), at kumuha ng invoice at books.
Irehistro ang empleyado sa SSS, PhilHealth, at Pag-IBIG kung kukuha ka ng tao.

items.title: Get a driver's license (LTO LTMS)
steps: Create an account on the LTO LTMS portal.
Take the required Theoretical Driving Course at an accredited driving school or LTO.
Apply for a Student Permit, then complete the Practical Driving Course.
Pass the written and practical exams at LTO for your Non-Professional/Professional license.
steps_tl: Gumawa ng account sa LTO LTMS portal.
Kumuha ng Theoretical Driving Course sa accredited na driving school o sa LTO.
Mag-apply ng Student Permit, tapos kumpletuhin ang Practical Driving Course.
Pumasa sa written at practical exam sa LTO para sa Non-Professional o Professional license.

items.title: Register as a voter (COMELEC)
steps: Check COMELEC announcements for the registration period (it stops before elections).
Fill out the application form (available online) and go to your local Election Officer with a valid ID.
Have your biometrics taken.
Check your precinct before election day.
steps_tl: Tingnan ang anunsyo ng COMELEC para sa panahon ng rehistrasyon (tumitigil ito bago ang eleksyon).
Punan ang application form (may online) at pumunta sa local Election Officer na may valid ID.
Ipakuha ang biometrics.
Alamin ang presinto mo bago ang araw ng eleksyon.

items.title: Request a PSA birth certificate
steps: Order online through PSA Serbilis (official PSA online service) or go to a PSA CRS outlet.
Fill in the details exactly as registered.
Pay through listed channels; delivery or pick-up follows.
For errors, ask your Local Civil Registrar about correction (RA 9048/10172).
steps_tl: Umorder online sa PSA Serbilis (opisyal na online service ng PSA) o pumunta sa PSA CRS outlet.
Ilagay ang detalye nang eksakto kung paano nakarehistro.
Magbayad sa nakalistang channel. Susunod ang delivery o pick-up.
Kung may mali, tanungin ang Local Civil Registrar tungkol sa koreksyon (RA 9048/10172).

items.title: Apply for scholarships: tips
steps: List scholarships that fit you (see Civi Scholarships: local and abroad).
Check eligibility and deadlines on the official page only.
Prepare documents early: grades, PSA birth certificate, income proof, essay.
Submit before the deadline and keep copies.
Never pay 'processing fees' to unofficial agents.
steps_tl: Ilista ang scholarship na bagay sa iyo (tingnan ang Civi Scholarships: lokal at abroad).
Tingnan ang eligibility at deadline sa opisyal na pahina lang.
Maagang ihanda ang dokumento: grades, PSA birth certificate, patunay ng kita, sanaysay.
Isumite bago ang deadline at magtabi ng kopya.
Huwag magbayad ng processing fee sa hindi opisyal na ahente.

items.title: Prepare a disaster go-bag
steps: Pack water, ready-to-eat food, flashlight, batteries and a whistle.
Add first aid kit, maintenance medicines, face masks, and hygiene items.
Keep copies of IDs and documents in a waterproof bag, plus some cash.
Know your evacuation center and family meeting place.
Follow PAGASA, PHIVOLCS and your LGU for warnings.
steps_tl: Mag-impake ng tubig, ready-to-eat na pagkain, flashlight, baterya, at sipol.
Magdagdag ng first-aid kit, maintenance na gamot, face mask, at hygiene items.
Magtabi ng kopya ng ID at dokumento sa waterproof na bag, at konting cash.
Alamin ang evacuation center at ang lugar ng pagkikita ng pamilya.
Sundin ang PAGASA, PHIVOLCS, at ang LGU para sa babala.

items.title: Request government documents (FOI)
steps: Find the agency on foi.gov.ph.
Describe exactly the document you want and why.
Submit and track your request online.
Agencies normally reply within the period set by the FOI rules; you can appeal a denial.
steps_tl: Hanapin ang ahensya sa foi.gov.ph.
Ilarawan nang eksakto ang dokumentong gusto mo at kung bakit.
Isumite at subaybayan ang request online.
Karaniwang sumasagot ang ahensya sa loob ng panahong itinakda ng FOI rules. Maaari mong iapela ang denial.

note_tl: Simpleng gabay ang mga hakbang sa petsang nakasaad. Nagbabago ang requirements at bayad: laging tingnan ang opisyal na site bago pumunta.
